_comment: Joiners, movers and leavers for scripts/manage-users.mjs. No secrets here.
'who', 'reportsTo', 'toManager' and 'reassignTo' match a username, a full name
or an email, and fall back to a single first name when only one person matches.
"@manager" on reassignTo means the person's own Area Manager; on toTeam it
"@same-as:<person>" on reportsTo or team copies that person's reporting line or team.
means the team of the manager being moved to.
Every TODO must be replaced before --apply will run.
